proposals.title: Spatial Domain Delineation via Integrated Clustering
proposals.summary: This analysis leverages spatially aware clustering algorithms that simultaneously incorporate gene expression profiles and spatial coordinate data to precisely locate contiguous tissue domains. By employing methods such as graph-based clustering or spatially constrained k-means, the approach avoids the pitfalls of pure gene-only clustering and reveals biologically coherent regions in complex tissues.

proposals.title: Multi-Section Spatial Alignment with Histological Priors
proposals.summary: This study focuses on aligning serial tissue sections by using both spatial transcriptomic data and corresponding histological images. Advanced registration algorithms capture the morphological landmarks and adjust for technical distortions, facilitating integrated analysis across slices while preserving inherent tissue architecture and enabling comparative analysis across specimens.

proposals.title: Spatial Deconvolution Incorporating Neighborhood Constraints
proposals.summary: A reference-based deconvolution method is designed to estimate cell type mixtures at each spatial capture spot while integrating information from local neighbors. This dual approach aids in resolving ambiguous mixed signals by enforcing spatial continuity, thus improving accuracy in heterogeneous regions and revealing local cellular interactions in intact tissue.

proposals.title: Localized Differential Expression Analysis within Tissue Microenvironments
proposals.summary: This analysis detects genes that are differentially expressed within specific spatial domains defined by local tissue microenvironments. By contrasting expression levels in spatially contiguous regions, the method dissects fine-scale regulatory patterns and functional differences between neighboring domains, offering insights into localized disease processes or developmental changes.

proposals.title: Spatially Informed Batch Correction for Multi-Platform Integration
proposals.summary: The proposed investigation develops techniques to jointly analyze spatial transcriptomic datasets collected from different platforms. The method focuses on correcting batch effects without losing spatial signals by embedding batch variables into spatial smoothing models, ensuring that real tissue-specific variations are maintained while technical noise is minimized.

proposals.title: Integration of Imaging-Based and Sequencing-Based Spatial Transcriptomics
proposals.summary: This approach aims to integrate high-resolution imaging-based spatial data with sequencing-based measurements. By co-registering these datasets, the analysis aligns detailed cellular morphology with transcriptomic profiles, enabling cross-validation of spatial patterns and enhancing the resolution of cell localization and tissue structural insights.

proposals.title: Trajectory Inference Along Spatial Gradients
proposals.summary: The study reconstructs dynamic cellular trajectories using spatial transcriptomic data by modeling gene expression changes along continuous spatial gradients. This method offers insights into how cell states evolve within the tissue context, revealing developmental processes or pathological transitions across spatially organized microenvironments.

proposals.title: Mapping of Tissue Interface Interactions via Spatial Co-Localization
proposals.summary: This analysis systematically identifies regions where distinct tissue types or cellular domains are in close proximity, suggesting potential interaction zones. By quantifying gene expression shifts and connectivity between these areas, the method uncovers candidate interfaces critical for processes like immune infiltration, tumor-stroma interactions, or tissue regeneration.

proposals.title: Spatial Multi-Omics Integration for Tissue Heterogeneity
proposals.summary: Combining spatial transcriptomics with other modalities such as spatial proteomics or metabolomics, this analysis integrates multi-omic measurements on the same tissue sections. Advanced data fusion techniques are applied to reveal complex multi-layered regulatory networks, offering a comprehensive view of tissue heterogeneity and microenvironmental interactions.

proposals.title: Automated Histological Annotation from Spatial Transcriptomic Profiles
proposals.summary: This project develops a machine learning pipeline that uses combined spatial gene expression and coordinate data to automatically annotate and classify histological structures. The analysis trains models on regions with known anatomical features, subsequently applying these classifiers to map subtle tissue architectures in complex samples with high precision.
